response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong general software engineering skills and 17 years of professional experience meeting the education requirement, his background is primarily in web, mobile, and application-level software development. The role requires specialized expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and hardware-software co-design for AI accelerators—areas where the candidate shows no significant experience. His recent work on AI-agent infrastructure is software-focused rather than hardware-focused optimization.
strengths: 17+ years of professional software development experience, exceeding the Bachelor's degree + 8 years requirement
Demonstrated expertise in performance optimization and low-latency systems (async I/O, caching, high-performance databases)
Recent experience contributing to AI-agent infrastructure, showing awareness of modern AI/ML systems
concerns: No SoC, IP modeling, or hardware architecture design experience—core requirements for the role
Career focused on web, mobile, and general software development rather than hardware optimization and accelerator design
Lacks GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD architecture, and deep learning workload optimization expertise at the hardware level

key_factors.factor: Years of experience and seniority level
